semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company supplies aluminum alloy materials that are used in high-end manufacturing, including semiconductors.
summary: ShenYang Merit Aircraft&Aerospace Materials Co.,LTD specializes in the distribution of high-quality aluminum alloy materials for high-end manufacturing sectors, including aerospace and semiconductors. They provide a range of aluminum alloys and consulting services to support the needs of semiconductor and precision manufacturing enterprises.
capabilities: Distribution of aluminum alloys such as 2024, 6061, and 7075
Application consulting services for aluminum materials
Inventory preparation and bonded business handling
technical_expertise: Quality assurance and compliance with aerospace standards

regional_presence.China: The company collaborates with major airports under the China Aviation Industry Corporation and operates an aerospace industrial park.
